FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.

2. When practising Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking Vocabulary Turn taking Intonation Nonverbal communication.

3. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.

6. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. livre
   C. fenêtre
   D. porte

7. When practising Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking Turn taking Nonverbal communication Intonation Questioning.

   B. Good morning / hello

9. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
